events.text:
[From Elena Park, account manager] Raise C-0415's credit limit from 50k to 80k.
They've just signed the three-year contract.
Let me check the customer and the credit policy.

events.name: get_customer
events.result:
C-0415 Lindqvist Marine. Account manager: Elena Park. Credit limit 50,000.00.
Payment history: 34 invoices, 0 late in 24 months.

events.name: get_credit_policy
events.result:
Account managers may approve credit limits up to 100,000.00 for their own accounts.
Limits above 100,000.00 need the credit manager. Every change must record a reason.

args.reason_for_change: Requested by Elena Park (account manager for C-0415) on 2026-10-21: customer has just signed a three-year contract. Increase 50,000 -> 80,000 is within the account manager approval limit (up to 100,000) under credit policy. Payment history: 34 invoices, 0 late in 24 months.

events.text:
I've raised Lindqvist Marine's (C-0415) credit limit from 50,000 to 80,000.

- **Approval:** You're the account manager on this account, and the credit policy lets account managers approve limits up to 100,000 on their own accounts. No one else needed to sign off.
- **Change reason:** The reason I logged says you asked for it today because of the new three-year contract. It also notes their payment history: 34 invoices in the last 24 months, none late.

If the account needs more than 100,000 later, the credit manager would have to approve it.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: Before changing the limit, the agent checked the customer and policy, confirming Elena Park owned the account and could approve limits up to 100,000.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The reason_for_change field records 'Requested by Elena Park' and that the customer 'has just signed a three-year contract.'

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The agent submitted the reason in reason_for_change, and the tool confirmed 'Reason recorded.'

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The agent confirmed the new limit of 80,000 and stated, 'The reason I logged says you asked for it today because of the new three-year contract.'
